description: Family 7 (docs/tasks.md section 8): proving claims within a budget. The prover's seconds and memory are the adopted measurement of the R_cap program proven with Stwo, named here by path and by the SHA-256 of its LF-normalized text; every other number is a bench decision.

provenance.cost_model: measured: cairo/rcap/measure.sh on this machine, one run per size on 2026-10-07 and three on 2026-10-08, merged by cairo/rcap/adopt.ts as the minimum wall seconds per size over all four (docs/tasks.md section 8.5)
provenance.arrivals: invented: a steady Poisson process at 2 per block, or a two-state Markov-modulated one with the same order of mean (1.6 per block); log-uniform values from 2,000 to 200,000 sats
provenance.max_proofs: invented: 48 a day where proofs are plentiful, 12 where they are scarce
provenance.prover_price_sats_per_second: invented: 5 sats per prover-second, a rented machine with the 15 GB the prover needs
provenance.staleness_ppm_per_block: invented: 50 parts per million of a claim's value per block it waits, about 0.7% a day
provenance.memory_ceiling_mib: invented: 64 GiB, which no measured batch reaches in v0
